opportunities.point: Buying below the model's intrinsic value leaves room for a re-rating.
opportunities.evidence: DCF intrinsic 228 vs price 115 - margin of safety 49.6%

opportunities.point: The company guides for a revenue growth CAGR of 30% and a PAT growth of 60% plus for the full year FY 2026.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "For the full year, our outlook for FY 2026 is to grow to at a CAGR of 30% in the terms of revenue and in terms of PAT about 60% plus." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

opportunities.point: Projected revenue for FY 2026 is estimated between nearly 147 crore to 150 crore with a PAT of 18,00,00,000 to 20,00,00,000.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "This would translate to a projected revenue of nearly 147 crore to 150 crore and with the estimated path of 18,00,00,000 to 20,00,00,000." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

opportunities.point: Management is exploring markets including Lajpat Nagar, Chandigarh, Old Gurgaon, Dubai, and Bangladesh for store expansion.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "So I first is that we would like to expand our stores for which we are exploring the following markets, which is Lajpat Nagar, Chandigarh, Old Gurgaon, Dubai and Bangladesh." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

opportunities.point: The company plans to add about 10 experience centers over the next 2 1/2 years.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "In total, over the next 2 1/2 years, we'll be adding about 10 experience centers." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

opportunities.point: Sales are outgrowing costs - operating leverage should widen margins.
Expectations baked into the price are low, so little has to go right.
Management noted that B2B customers increased from 1,161 to 1,282 and B2C customers from 50,000 to 53,000.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "In terms of B2B customers, we have added from 1,161 to 1,282 B2B customers and in B2C we have added from 50,000 to 53,000 customers." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

opportunities.point: The company added 2,000 plus new product choices to strengthen its portfolio.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Also we have made our product portfolio strengthened by nearly 2000 plus new choice introductions." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

opportunities.point: Management targets to increase B2C revenue percentage from 13-14% to 20 to 25% by 2028.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "It will take some time, but we feel that by 2028, when all these 10 experience centres are fully functional and firing, we will be able to achieve our vision." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01)

opportunities.point: Management expects to finalize the Lajpat Nagar store rental deal next month and get possession in February.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "So we are already in process of closing the Lajpat Nagar store rental deal and we are expecting by next month we'll finalize it and hopefully we'll get the possession of that store in February and we'll try to make it up and running by 25th March." (concall transcript - 2025-12-01) [next month]

threats.point: The business consumed cash from operations in the latest year.
Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 12 -> 18 Cr (Mar 2026) but operating cash flow 3 Cr (Mar 2025) -> -40 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: Receivables are stretching year on year.
Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -7.57 pp, DII -4.83 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Small size brings liquidity and volatility risk.
